title: Extraction Result
x-canonicalization-profile: PBGC Case Workbench Canonicalization Profile v1

x-deterministic-array-semantics.observations: order-significant; preserve parser-established physical source order using source locator and occurrence; implementations must not reorder
x-deterministic-array-semantics.limitations: set-like; trim and NFC-normalize, sort by case-folded text then original NFC text; reject case-fold-equivalent duplicates

x-numeric-canonicalization: Finite JSON numbers in observedValue use RFC 8785 serialization; equivalent notation hashes identically, negative zero serializes as 0, and NaN/infinities are invalid. When valueType is decimal-string, observedValue must be a string matching governed-records canonicalDecimalString because lexical decimal precision is material.
x-recursive-deterministic-json: Object keys canonicalize recursively. Arrays at exact registered paths use those rules. Every otherwise-unregistered array, including arrays nested at any depth inside observedValue, is order-significant by default and preserves element order. Exact path rules do not propagate to descendants.
